title: Rust: LoRa airtime formula (SF/BW/CR/preamble/payload)
description: LoRa airtime calculation. AC: Formula matches SX127x datasheet, handles all SF/BW/CR combinations.
notes: Implemented integer-only, no_std SX127x LoRa airtime calculation in lichen-core with validated SF6-SF12, all ten bandwidths, CR 4/5-4/8, preamble and payload bounds, automatic/explicit low-data-rate optimization, implicit/explicit header, and CRC terms. Added canonical packets-timing consumers for SF9/60B and CCP profile maximum payload. Green: cargo test -p lichen-core; cargo fmt -p lichen-core -- --check; cargo check -p lichen-core --lib --no-default-features; cargo clippy -p lichen-core --lib --no-default-features -- -D warnings; cargo clippy -p lichen-core --test airtime_vectors --no-default-features -- -D warnings. Full --all-targets clippy remains blocked by unrelated pre-existing warnings in duty_cycle/lib tests and yggdrasil_addr_vectors.
